title: Home Invasion (Short 2025)
overview: Four friends, Ty, Adam, Ibrahim, and Kyrie, are drinking at Ty's place and invite four women, Isabella, Faye, Shantelle, and Dani and enjoy themselves. Ibrahim feels something is amiss, but his friends disregard his fears to enjoy their time. Meanwhile, three men in masks, Pedro, Andre, and Hakeem, are raiding a house to get a bag of money stored there. As night advances, Ibrahim hears men in his house upstairs making a noise and discovers that they are with the women. He reports to his friends, but his fears are again put aside as foolish.
